summary: v4 (Classes/YouTube, Referrals PPxxxxxx, Wallet+QR, Withdrawals, Item commission) tested. Backend: 53/53 pytest (20 new v4 + 33 carried). Frontend: CRITICAL missing dep `react-native-svg` caused Metro red screen on every route. I installed it (`yarn add react-native-svg@15.15.4`), cleared metro cache, restarted expo — app now loads. Verified end-to-end: register → welcome modal shows PPxxxxxx, navigate to /wallet (balance, ₹200 sign-up bonus label, referral code rendered), QR button opens modal (react-native-qrcode-svg now resolves), Classes tab mounts with list container. Backend bug discovered: rejection notification branch dead-code (string literal mismatch).

critical.issue: WithdrawalDecisionIn Literal accepts ['approve','reject','paid'] but handler at line 1006 checks `new_status == 'rejected'` (never matches) — rejection notification is never inserted. Also persisted status is 'reject'/'approve' (not past tense), so frontend wallet.tsx wdColor() badge only styles 'paid' correctly; 'reject'/'approve' fall through to warning color. Fix: either change Literal to ['approve','reject','paid'] + compare to 'reject'/'approve' AND normalize stored status to approved/rejected; simplest: map body.decision → 'approved'|'rejected'|'paid' before persisting.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing peer dep `react-native-svg` caused Metro red screen ('Unable to resolve module react-native-svg') on every route including /register, /wallet, (parent)/*. Installed react-native-svg@15.15.4 and restarted expo — this unblocks the whole app.

integration_issues.issue: wallet.tsx wdColor() expects 'approved'/'rejected'/'paid' but backend persists 'approve'/'reject'/'paid' — only 'paid' renders correct color.

action_items: Backend: Normalize withdrawal decision → 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'paid' before writing to DB, then the existing `if new_status == 'rejected'` branch will fire and the frontend badges will match. Alternative: update frontend wdColor() to accept 'approve'/'reject'. Fixing backend is preferred.
Frontend package.json: add react-native-svg as an explicit dependency (tester already installed 15.15.4). Verify `yarn.lock` is committed.

Classes tab: Optionally add a testID on individual cards is already there (`video-<id>`). During UI run, `videos` list was empty for a freshly-focused Classes tab because the ScrollView rendered before load() resolved; this is eventual-consistent and matches expectation but adds a perceivable blank state — consider a skeleton loader.

register handler correctly uppercases referrer_code (lowercase accepted).

wallet balance is computed by aggregating transactions (no separate balance field) — ensures consistency with withdrawal_paid negative txn.

rca_of_issue: 1) RED SCREEN RCA: package.json declares react-native-qrcode-svg@6.3.21 but missed its peer dep react-native-svg. On first bundle resolution, Metro failed with 'Unable to resolve module react-native-svg' turning every route into an error page. Repro: navigate to /register — red screen. Mitigation applied: `yarn add react-native-svg`, restart expo. 2) REJECTION NOTIFICATION RCA: Pydantic Literal uses short verb forms ('reject') but handler compares to 'rejected'. Repro: POST /api/admin/withdrawals/{id}/decide {decision:'reject'} → withdrawal.status becomes 'reject' but no notification inserted. Mitigation: map decision to past-tense form before persisting + before comparison.
